releases.notes:
## GUI overhaul

- Fixed two label glitches: status text no longer renders inside the name field, dig-direction label no longer overlaps the loot grid
- Name field, dig-direction buttons and Start/Stop moved above the golem's inventory
- Color-coded live status in the header with a state dot (Mining / Idle / Paused / Inventory full / Done)
- Tooltips on the name field and direction buttons
- Ghost slot hints now use greyed-out vanilla item art (diamond pickaxe/shovel, torch)
- Vanilla-style rounded panel corners
- New stats column: **Blocks** (minable with remaining tool durability) and **Tunnel** (dig length covered by torches)
- Fixed rendering on Minecraft 26.3: full-alpha label colors, panel-relative label coordinates, no drop shadow on labels
- Setting the already-active dig direction is now a server-side no-op (protects running jobs)

**Install:** drop `mininggolem-1.0.1.jar` (and Fabric API) into your `mods` folder.

releases.notes:
Initial release.

A copper-golem-like helper that digs an endless ring strip-mine network for you.

**Highlights**
- Spawn ritual: diamond block + jack o'lantern (or creative spawn egg)
- Endless ring-tunnel pattern — every tunnel pair connected at both ends
- Vein mining + exposed-ore checking (tier-aware)
- Pickaxes & shovels with auto-switching and vanilla-like break speeds
- Torches every 10 columns, floor bridging over holes
- Water/lava/gravel-proof: fire-immune, no fluid push, digs itself free
- Keeps mining while you're away (chunk tickets), resumes after reload
- Pick it up (sneak + right-click) and redeploy it anywhere
- GUI: tools/torches/loot, naming, dig direction, live status
- Debug mode: `/mininggolem debug`

**Requires:** Minecraft 26.3 · Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.5 · Fabric API · Java 25

readmeSummary: A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3 that adds a diamond-textured copper-golem-like helper which digs a serpentine strip-mine network for you — gathering loot, lighting tunnels with torches and bridging...
